book.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
who_for: Fans of detective and mystery fiction
Students of Victorian literature and crime writing
Readers who enjoy clever plot construction and deduction
learnings: Explore Doyle's method of logical deduction through Holmes's reasoning.
Understand how the collection shaped the detective fiction genre.
Read the original twelve stories without modern adaptation material.
book.description: A clean, structured reader edition of Arthur Conan Doyle's 1892 collection.
book.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
benefits: Read the foundational collection of the world's most famous detective.
Enjoy a clean, structured reading format.
Read twelve classic detective stories in a structured edition.
book.about_author: Arthur Conan Doyle (1859–1930) was a British author and physician, best known for creating the fictional detective Sherlock Holmes, one of the most enduring characters in Western storytelling.
